Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting (Approved with change)

  Thursday, November 21, 2024, at 10:00 a.m.
1. ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on November 21, 2024, at 10:01 a.m.
  •  Present: Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Zadorian (joined meeting at 10:08 am),
  Ataian, Kazorian, Chairperson Vidor
  The Agenda for the November 21, 2024, Regular Meeting was posted on November 14,
  2024, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.

  a. Minutes of the October 17, 2024 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

  Moved:  Vice Chair Yank
  Seconded :  Chairperson Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Abstain:  Commissioners Ataian, Kazorian

3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator

  •  Ms. Loreto Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library,
  Arts & Culture locations.

3. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS
  • None

5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.

  •  Speaker: Allen Dish, pianist thanked the Commission for the pianos that were installed
  throughout the city and requested to restore the pianos and the public use of the pianos
  with a sign up system that would allow the public to use the piano at Brand Library.
  1
 6. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Alex Film Society - Sponsorship Opportunity
  1. Motion approving (1) the funding of a proposal by the Alex Film Society to provide arts
  programming associated with the Outdoor Movies at the Doctors House Film Series from
  June – September 2025, and (2) the sponsorship in an amount not to exceed $5,000
  From the 2024-2025 Work Plan.

  •  Stephen Meek, board member of the Alex Film Society presented on the outdoor film
  series at the Doctors House Film Series and requested the Commission offsetting costs.
  •  Chair Vidor opened the dais to Randy Carter current President of the Alex Film Society
  who gave a brief history on the program. The Commission asked questions and gave their
  feedback.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves (1) the funding of a proposal by the
  Alex Film Society to provide programming associated with Outdoor Movies at the Doctor’s
  House Series from June – September 2025, and (2) the sponsorship of programming in an
  amount not to exceed $5,000 from the 2024 - 2025 Work Plan, as more fully outlined in the
  November 21, 2024 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture
  Administrator.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Vice Chair Yank

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Ataian, Kazorian

b. Arts and Culture Commission – Grant Program
  1. Motion directing Staff to research grant programs and present recommendations on a
  proposed grant program for the Arts and Culture Commission at the December 19, 2024
  Arts and Culture Commission Meeting.

  •  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated Councilmember Kassakhian recommended that the Arts and
  Culture Commission develop a grant program for arts and culture organizations within the
  city for events or rent subsidy. She stated staff is requesting feedback from the
  Commission to investigate all the opportunities and models for grant programs that can be
  potentially implemented in the City of Glendale. Staff would come back next month and
  provide recommendations. The Commission asked questions and recommended that one
  Commission Member be appointed to an Arts and Culture Grant Program Committee to
  assist Staff in developing a grant program. Staff would share recommendations at an
  upcoming Arts and Culture Commission Meeting.
  •  Commissioner Tufenkian requested to agendize the 2024-2025 budget for review.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby directs Staff to research grant programs and
  present recommendations on a proposed grant program for the Arts and Culture Commission
  at the December 19, 2024 Arts and Culture Commission Meeting, as more fully outlined in the

  2
   November 21, 2024 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture
  Administrator.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Vice Chair Yank

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Ataian, Kazorian

7. DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. Arts and Culture Commission Programs – Survey Analysis

  •  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that in February 2024, the Arts and Culture Commission began
  working with Ms. Courtney Dean, a Claremont Graduate student – Federal Work Study
  Program Assistant. She stated that Ms. Dean is ending her tenure next month and during her
  tenure with the City of Glendale, Ms. Dean has worked with Loreto Lopez, Program
  Coordinator, to implement audience surveys of Arts and Culture Commission programs.
  •  Ms. Dean presented her findings on audience surveys for Arts and Culture Commission
  programs as a culmination to her tenure with the City of Glendale. The Commission asked
  questions and gave their feedback.

  b. 2024 – 2025 Work Plan Progress Updates

  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave a brief update on current projects and programs of the 2024-2025
  Arts and Culture Work Plan.

a.  CITY WIDE ARTS
  i.  Mural Ordinance – Update
  Staff is in the process of finalizing the Mural Ordinance. Staff is hoping to present the
  draft in January to the Commission for review and feedback then host a community
  input meeting in Spring and ultimately heading to City Council.

b.  NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS
  i. Beyond the Box: Utility Box Mural Art Program – Update
  From October 18 – 20, 2024, 12 artists painted new murals as part of the Beyond the Box:
  Utility Box Mural Art Program. This year’s theme was “Art and Science: Collide” in
  alignment with the City of Glendale’s participation in the Getty PST: Art and Science Collide
  initiative.

  ii.  Creative Crosswalks: San Fernando Road Beautification Project – Update
  Five Creative Crosswalk designs were installed as part of the San Fernando Road
  Beautification Project in October 2024. The Public Works department (along with four
  other agencies) received the American Public Works Association (APWA) B.E.S.T
  (Building Excellence Shaping Tomorrow) Project of the Year Award in the Traffic, Mobility,
  and Beautification category by the APWA, Southern California Chapter for the San
  Fernando Road Rehabilitation Project. Ms. Fukutomi-Parks thanked Public Works for their

  3
   partnership and shared the art designs with the Commission. The Commission gave their
  feedback.

c.  PERFORMING ARTS – No Update.

d.  ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS
  i.  Be the Change: Dia de los Muertos Event – Update
  GLAC staff will be attending the December 19, 2024 Arts and Culture Commission
  Meeting to present a re-cap on this year’s Dia de los Muertos Event as part of the Be the
  Change: I.D.E.A. programming.

e.  MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS
  i. “Blended Worlds” Exhibit: Marketing and Public Relations – Update
  The ACE Agency and GLAC Marketing staff will be attending the December 19, 2024 Arts
  and Culture Commission Meeting to provide an overview on the marketing and public
  relations outreach for the “Blended Worlds” exhibit at Brand Library & Art Center.

8. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  • Vice Chair Yank wanted an update on the current Arts and Culture commissioner
  vacancy. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that she has not received an update on
  applications or review process.
  • Commissioner Tufenkian stated she would like to look at the Palmer Park Basketball
  Court Mural and agendize to rescind the Motion from the September 19, 2024 Regular
  Arts and Culture Commission Meeting.
  • Chairperson Vidor stated she would like to agendize for the December 19th meeting
  what the Commission has so far on the Olympic/Para Olympic strategy, receive
  Commission input and discuss next steps. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated she has been in
  conversations with the City of Los Angeles who received the bid for the 2028 Olympic
  Games, in addition to LA County and other municipalities. She will share more on the
  discussions regarding the 2028 Olympics conversation during the upcoming meeting.
  Vice Chair Yank seconded to agendize the Olympics.
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that in the December 19th meeting the Library Arts and
  Culture Marketing staff Maryl Fleisher and Michelle Turner, will be invited to talk about
  the marketing and PR they did for Blended Worlds and the Ace Agency will also be
  invited to share all they’ve done, and Library staff will present an overview of Dia de Los
  Muertos festivities. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that Mayor Asatryan suggested that the
  Arts and Culture Commission host a Arts and Culture mixer some time in Spring 2025
  and staff will be working on that.
  • The Commission thanked Ms. Courtney Dean for her work with the Commission.

9. ADJOURNMENT 10:56 a.m.
  Moved: Vice Chair Yank
  Seconded: Commissioner Zadorian

The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday, December 19,
2024 at 10:00 AM in City Council Chambers – 613 E. Broadway Glendale, CA 91206
